textTranslated:
- We visited the cafe while waiting to check into our hotel. It's located right on the main street, so it was easy to find. The space is spacious, airy, and has multiple floors. Besides the coffee area, there's also a souvenir shop inside and a workshop upstairs. If you don't like climbing the stairs, sitting on the first floor is quite comfortable.

- The drinks and pastries here are relatively expensive compared to the average. Basically, nothing is particularly outstanding. I tried the mixed berry drink and found it easy to drink, with a lovely strawberry aroma. If you don't like sweet drinks, you should try this one.

- The cake selection isn't very diverse, with very few options, so I tried the tiramisu.

- One thing that impressed me about the cafe is the staff's enthusiasm and attentiveness. When we arrived, we had two large suitcases, and the staff proactively helped carry them up the stairs, which felt very thoughtful.

- Overall, the cafe has a pleasant atmosphere, a convenient location, and good service; the prices are a bit high, but the experience is good.

text:

WONDERLUST – Coffee & Souvenir is definitely one of the best cafés I have visited in Da Nang! I also love the souvenir section, which adds a unique touch to the café and makes it a lovely place to find memorable gifts from Vietnam.

Overall, WONDERLUST is more than just a café; it is a wonderful experience. I highly recommend visiting this place if you are in Da Nang. I will definitely come back again! ❤️

text:
Wonderlust thì nổi tiếng nhiều năm nay rồi. Từ quán cà phê cho khách địa phương cho tới địa điểm của khách du lịch. Nằm ở vị trí đắc địa nên khá là đông khách nước ngoài. Thiết kế nội thất cũng khá là đẹp.

Cà phê, lúc trước có thêm bánh và bruch. Hiện tại là cà phê và tráng miệng. Tầng 1 có khu ngồi ngoài trời.

Tầng 3 từng được dùng cho không gian worlshop, meeting giờ đã tạm thời đóng cửa.
textTranslated:
Wonderlust has been famous for many years. From a café catering to locals to a popular tourist destination, its prime location attracts a large number of foreign visitors. The interior design is also quite beautiful.

The café is a three-story building with a basement. Free parking is available in the basement, with attendants on duty.

They previously offered coffee, along with pastries and brusch. Currently, they serve coffee and desserts. The first floor has an outdoor seating area.

The café also features retail space for various brands, offering a wide variety of goods. The second floor houses a large shop with many local souvenirs.

The third floor, formerly used for workshops and meetings, is now temporarily closed.

text:
I liked this cafe. Nice vibe and design. Staff are very helpful and attentive.

I had a flat white with oat milk which cost 91,000 VND. That’s expensive compared to other cafes in Da Nang in my opinion which charge around 55-65,000. The electricity went off and therefore so did the wifi which I needed to work so I had to go to another cafe. They did discount my flat white 10% because of that but honestly 10% discount didn’t really make much difference to me. I paid 83,000.

Only the lower two floors are open. The upper floor is still closed. There is a co- working room up there but you can’t use it. That’s a shame for me, I would have loved to use that to work for a few hours away from the noise caused by other customers and children. Although that noise wasn’t a problem for me today too much.
responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for visiting Wonderlust and for taking the time to share such detailed feedback. We’re glad you enjoyed the atmosphere and design, and especially happy to hear that our team made you feel well taken care of.

We’re sorry that the unexpected power outage interrupted your time with us, particularly as you were planning to work. While our team offered a small discount at the time, we completely understand that it couldn’t make up for the inconvenience caused.

Regarding the upper floor, this area is currently not part of our regular seating space. Our co-working room is available separately for a usage fee rather than as part of the café’s general seating, which is why it may not always be accessible during a regular visit.

We also appreciate your perspective on the pricing. Our drinks are made with carefully selected ingredients and a strong focus on preparation and quality, which is reflected in how we price our menu.

Thank you again for the thoughtful feedback and for the kind words about our space and team. We hope to welcome you back for a smoother experience next time.

text:
Отрицательное впечатление от данного заведения. Предложение посетить данное заведение вышло от ИИ ассистента, решили что и правда хороший выбор. И придя на место - красивый интерьер и антураж заставил поверить в правильность этого. Но…

При таком высоком ценнике ожидаешь что-то по настоящему вкусное.
Брали кофе и мороженое.
Колд брю был со странным привкусом. Как и мороженое с манго. Порции к тому же небольшие. Вот прям маленькие.
Чувство как будто пришел в ночной клуб, где напиток достаточно обозначить. А оценивать его вкус и объем как будто ни кто не будет.

Когда дальше по улице ты можешь выпить большой стакан вкусного кофе за 50.000, переплачивать за вид в два раза больше и пить не вкусный - сомнительный вариант.
textTranslated:
Negative impression of this establishment. The suggestion to visit this place came from an AI assistant; we thought it was a really good choice. And when we got there, the beautiful interior and surroundings made us believe it was the right choice. But...

With such a high price tag, you expect something truly delicious.
We ordered coffee and ice cream.
The cold brew had a strange aftertaste. So did the mango ice cream. The portions were also small. Like, really small.
It felt like I'd walked into a nightclub where you only need to name the drink. And it's as if no one will be judging its taste and volume.

When you can get a large glass of delicious coffee down the street for 50,000, paying twice as much for the view and drinking something that tastes bad is a dubious option.
responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to visit Wonderlust and for sharing such detailed feedback about your experience.

We're truly sorry that your visit did not meet your expectations, especially after choosing Wonderlust based on previous recommendations and reviews. 

At Wonderlust, we are committed to crafting handcrafted beverages that celebrate the natural character of each ingredient. Because of this, our drinks may not suit everyone's personal taste or expectations. However, that never means we take our guests' experiences for granted.

Your comments regarding the flavor of the drinks, the dessert, the portion size, and the overall value are genuinely appreciated. Our team will carefully take them into consideration as we continue reviewing and refining the experience we strive to offer every guest.

Thank you again for your honest feedback. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back someday and provide you with a much better experience.

為什麼有吃到飽套餐

我吃到一半問有沒有吃到飽，還說有，但我是單點
東西好吃，但希望一開始點餐能明確說明告知

textTranslated:
Why do they offer all-you-can-eat套餐 (set meals) but only give customers à la carte menus?

I asked halfway through my meal if they had all-you-can-eat套餐, and they said yes, but I ordered à la carte. The food was good, but I hope they can clearly state this when I order.

When I saw the à la carte menu, my first thought was that the restaurant should switch to à la carte. I really didn't expect that they had all-you-can-eat套餐 but only gave us à la carte menus. I was both dumbfounded and angry.

text:
Phải nói là một trong những quán hot pot đáng thử nhất luôn á mọi người ơiii 😭❤️ Nước lẩu đậm đà, thơm ngon, topping tươi rói, thịt nhúng mềm tan, ăn cuốn không lối thoát. I have to say, this is one of the best hot pot restaurants ever, everyone! 😭❤️ The broth is rich and flavorful, the toppings are fresh, and the meat is tender and melts in your mouth – it's incredibly addictive. The food comes out quickly, is beautifully presented, and the space is clean and comfortable, perfect for dining with friends, your significant other, or family. 🥩🍲

A huge plus is the enthusiastic and friendly staff who provide attentive service from start to finish, creating a very pleasant experience. The food quality is excellent for the price; you'll want to come back again and again! 🫶🏻

Overall, the experience exceeded expectations; from the food to the service, there's nothing to complain about. Hot pot lovers definitely have to try this place! Highly recommend!!! 💯✨ I'll definitely be back and support this restaurant for a long time! ❤️‍🔥

text:
Đã ghé ăn rất nhiều lần nhưng có lẽ đây sẽ là lần cuối cùng.
20h38p mới ghé quán, 20:45 - 20:50 đồ mới lên, mới bắt đầu ăn. Thế mà 22h nhân viên đã có ý muốn đuổi khách :)))
Quán thì để mở đến 2h sáng chứ có phải sắp đóng cửa đâu mà đi lau sàn, còn lau đúng lúc khách đang ăn, còn "nhờ chị nhấc chân lên giúp em" để lau sàn. Ý là ăn nhiều quá, ăn lâu quá, nhanh nhanh lượn đi để tụi tao còn dọn dẹp hay gì 🙂
Mới gọi đồ đến lượt thứ 2 thôi đó. Không muốn ăn nữa luôn. 1 suất cả VAT, nước cũng hết 400k mà... thật sự.
textTranslated:
I've eaten here many times, but this will probably be the last.
I arrived at the restaurant at 8:38 PM, and the food didn't arrive until 8:45-8:50 PM, just as I started eating. And yet, at 10 PM, the staff were already trying to kick me out :)))
The restaurant is open until 2 AM, it's not like they're about to close, so why are they mopping the floor? And they're doing it right when customers are eating, even asking me to "lift my leg" so they can mop the floor. It's like they're saying, "You're eating too much, taking too long, hurry up and leave so we can clean up."

I'd only ordered twice. I didn't want to eat anymore. One meal, including VAT and drinks, cost 400k VND... seriously.
responseFromOwnerText: Trước tiên Gangyu xin cảm ơn vì trước giờ quý khách vẫn ủng hộ quán. Về phản hồi của mình, Gangyu rất xin lỗi vì nhân viên đã có thái độ phục vụ không chuyên nghiệp. Khách đến với Gangyu đều cần được phục vụ chu đáo, nhiệt tình , Gangyu hiểu điều đó và luôn trân trọng cũng như cảm ơn quý khách. Về nội bộ, Gangyu sẽ chỉnh đốn lại đội ngũ nhân viên để tránh tình trạng này tái diễn. Một lần nữa xin cảm ơn quý khách đã để lại đánh giá để Gangyu sửa đổi và cải thiện tốt hơn. Chúc quý vui và rất mong có cơ hội đón tiếp mình lần nữa ạ.

text:
很漂亮的咖啡廳，不管是外側到內裝都非常的吸引人。一樓可以停放摩托車，對於騎車來的小夥伴非常的方便。
店內採取自助式，找到你想座的位子在掃碼點單，這點對老人家或許有點不方便，但是對於年輕人來說是一點難度都沒有。
在地圖上看到布丁的賣相不錯，於是就點了一份，55000越南盾不算太貴，但是口感我覺得一般，跟福岡的FUK布丁差距還是挺遠的，只是賣相真的不錯。另外還點了一杯鹽咖啡，其實在峴港喝過不少鹽咖啡，這間的味道我認為只能算尚可。也或許不是我喜歡的味道，相較於其他家的稍微弱了點。不過這裡勝在環境，內挑高的感覺會顯得裡面很大沒有壓迫感。
另外最裡面還有伴手禮商店，這點很特別也加分，有不是精緻的伴手禮提供挑選，原本想買件衣服做紀念，無奈沒有我要的尺碼，有點小遺憾。不過店員妹妹很漂亮，而且服務很好又親切。
總體來說還是值得過來打卡一下的，對於喜愛咖啡的小夥伴不要錯過了。
textTranslated:
A very beautiful cafe, both the exterior and interior are very attractive. Motorcycles can be parked on the first floor, which is very convenient for those who ride bikes.

The cafe is self-service; you find your desired seat and scan a QR code to order. This might be a little inconvenient for the elderly, but it's no problem for young people.

The pudding looked good on the map, so I ordered one. At 55,000 VND, it wasn't too expensive, but I thought the taste was just average. It's quite different from the FUK pudding in Fukuoka, only the presentation was really good. I also ordered a salt coffee. I've had quite a few salt coffees in Da Nang, and I think this one was only so-so. Perhaps it's not my preferred taste; it was slightly weaker than other cafes. However, the ambiance is a plus; the high ceilings make the space feel spacious and not cramped.

There's also a souvenir shop at the far end, which is unique and a plus. They offer a selection of not-so-exquisite souvenirs. I originally wanted to buy a piece of clothing as a souvenir, but unfortunately, they didn't have my size, which was a bit of a disappointment. However, the female staff member was very pretty, and the service was excellent and friendly.

Overall, it's definitely worth a visit; coffee lovers shouldn't miss it.

text:
I understand that the restaurant has two menus: à la carte and buffet. However, I think the staff should introduce all the available options instead of simply giving me the à la carte menu and only showing me the buffet menu after I asked about it.

The atmosphere was also extremely noisy. I understand that guests can be loud, but the staff were also making a lot of noise while cleaning. They were casually talking and shouting to each other from the kitchen to the dining area, and dishes were being placed down very loudly. I honestly couldn’t tell if this was a restaurant serving customers or their own home. It was really difficult to enjoy dinner in such a messy and noisy environment.

This was my first visit and definitely my last. I think there are many hot pot restaurants in Da Nang with a similar style and price range, but with much better service than this place.

text:
岘港这家火锅餐厅简直太正宗啦！地理位置很好，就在龙桥和教堂、韩市场附近。上下两层，座位很宽敞，有空调和风扇，一点都不热。
菜品可以点零点和自助的，牛肉的品质不错，下货类好齐全啊！毛肚、肥肠、鸭胗、鸭肠、牛骨髓…那样都有。自助调料也很好吃。
服务员态度特别好，好几位都会中文，菜单中国人和本地人都一样的价格，下次愿意再来！
textTranslated:
This hot pot restaurant in Da Nang is absolutely authentic! The location is fantastic, near the Dragon Bridge, the church, and the Korean market. It has two floors, spacious seating, and air conditioning and fans keep it cool.

The menu offers both à la carte and buffet options. The beef is of good quality, and the selection of offal is amazing! Tripe, pork intestines, duck gizzards, duck intestines, beef bone marrow… they have it all. The self-service condiments are also delicious.

The service is exceptionally good; several staff members speak Chinese, and the prices are the same for both Chinese and locals. I'd definitely come back!

textTranslated: This place is a total rip-off. They sell 15 shrimp, and if you don't order them all at once, they'll tell you they're out when you try to order again. They're open until 2 AM, and at 9 PM they said they were out of shrimp? It's ridiculous. If they can't afford it, they shouldn't be in business. And then they secretly add a tax to the price, which is absurd. Even more ridiculous, another table wanted to pay in RMB, and they quoted them 3400 RMB at the exchange rate, when it's only 3900 RMB outside. They're basically ripping people off. I really don't recommend coming here. The Vietnamese food was quite good, though.

text:
A Delightful Experience at Wonderlust Coffee & Souvenir Da Nang❣️

📍Wonderlust at 96 Tran Phu is genuinely a must-visit spot in Da Nang! It's more than just a coffee shop; it's a beautiful complex that offers a unique blend of relaxation and curated shopping.

🫶🏻Airy, Green, and Inspiring Ambiance
What struck me most was the ambiance. The café is designed in a modern, minimalist style, primarily using white and black, but it's wonderfully softened by cascading greenery and potted plants, creating an incredibly "chill" outdoor balcony/hallway area (as seen in the photos). The space is flooded with natural light, and the combination of wooden accents and track lighting cultivates a refreshing, relaxed atmosphere—perfect for working or catching up with friends.

🫶🏻Creative and Top-Notch Beverages: The Signature Salted Coffee!
The drinks here truly elevated my visit. I tried the famous Iced Salted Coffee (as shown in the photo). This is a perfect fusion of bold Vietnamese phin coffee and a creamy salted foam on top. The taste was absolutely delicious and unique: the slight bitterness of the coffee was perfectly balanced by the savory, rich creaminess of the foam. The beautiful presentation, garnished with a tiny coffee bean, was a major plus. This drink is definitely a must-try when you visit Wonderlust!

🫶🏻Charming Souvenir Corner
A special highlight of Wonderlust is its souvenir area featuring products from local brands. I spent a good amount of time browsing and managed to pick out many beautiful souvenirs for my loved ones (like the MEW ROASTERY coffee packets and the cute wooden spoon in the gift box). From unique coffee blends and notebooks to handcrafted items, everything was stylish and high-quality. The ability to enjoy a delicious drink while selecting meaningful gifts in such a beautiful space made for a truly complete experience.

❣️In summary: Wonderlust Da Nang is not just a café with exceptional Salted Coffee; it's a worthwhile architectural space and a delightful shopping experience. I highly recommend everyone stop by!

text:
WONDERLUST – Coffee & Souvenir nằm tại số 96 Trần Phú, quận Hải Châu, Đà Nẵng. Mình ghé quán vào một buổi sáng cuối tuần, khi phố xá còn chưa quá đông. Quán có vị trí thuận tiện, gần trung tâm, dễ tìm, lại có tầng hầm để xe nên không phải loay hoay tìm chỗ gửi.

Ấn tượng đầu tiên là không gian được thiết kế rất chỉn chu. Tông màu gỗ kết hợp ánh sáng tự nhiên tạo cảm giác ấm cúng nhưng vẫn hiện đại. Quán chia làm nhiều khu: tầng trệt là khu order và ngồi uống, tầng trên là khu bán quà lưu niệm – từ cà phê đóng gói đến đồ thủ công nhỏ xinh. Mình thấy cách bố trí này khá thông minh, vừa tiện cho khách vừa tạo thêm chiều sâu cho trải nghiệm.

Mình gọi một ly iced coffee và một phần pancake. Cà phê đậm, thơm, không bị chua gắt, uống vào tỉnh táo nhưng vẫn dễ chịu. Pancake mềm, không quá ngọt, ăn kèm sốt trái cây và kem tươi, khá hài hòa. Ngoài ra, quán còn có các món như matcha, cappuccino, tiramisu, mango iced tea… nhìn chung menu phong phú, giá dao động từ 30.000–100.000 đồng, phù hợp với mặt bằng quán kiểu boutique.

Phục vụ ở đây chuyên nghiệp. Nhân viên lịch sự, không quá thân mật nhưng luôn sẵn sàng hỗ trợ. Mình order qua điện thoại như hướng dẫn, sau đó nhân viên xác nhận lại và mang đồ ra – cách làm này giúp giảm thời gian chờ và tránh nhầm lẫn.

Tổng thể, WONDERLUST là một điểm đến đáng thử nếu bạn đang ở Đà Nẵng và muốn tìm một quán cà phê có gu, không gian đẹp, đồ uống chất lượng và thêm chút trải nghiệm mua sắm nhẹ nhàng. Không phải kiểu quán đông đúc hay ồn ào, mà là nơi để bạn ngồi lại, thư giãn và tận hưởng một buổi sáng chậm rãi.
textTranslated:
WONDERLUST – Coffee & Souvenir is located at 96 Tran Phu Street, Hai Chau District, Da Nang. I visited the cafe on a weekend morning when the streets weren't too crowded. The cafe has a convenient location, near the city center, easy to find, and has underground parking, so there's no need to worry about finding a place to park.

My first impression was that the space was very well-designed. The combination of wood tones and natural light creates a cozy yet modern atmosphere. The cafe is divided into several areas: the ground floor is for ordering and drinking, while the upper floor sells souvenirs – from packaged coffee to cute little handicrafts. I found this layout quite clever, convenient for customers and adding depth to the experience.

I ordered an iced coffee and a pancake. The coffee was strong, aromatic, not too sour, and refreshing yet pleasant. The pancake was soft, not too sweet, and the combination with fruit sauce and whipped cream was quite harmonious. In addition, the cafe offers items like matcha, cappuccino, tiramisu, mango iced tea… overall, the menu is diverse, with prices ranging from 30,000 to 100,000 VND, suitable for a boutique-style establishment.

The service here is professional. The staff are polite, not overly friendly, but always ready to assist. I ordered by phone as instructed, then the staff confirmed and brought the order – this method reduces waiting time and avoids mistakes.

Overall, WONDERLUST is a worthwhile destination if you are in Da Nang and want to find a stylish cafe with a beautiful space, quality drinks, and a relaxing shopping experience. It's not a crowded or noisy place, but rather a place where you can sit back, relax, and enjoy a leisurely morning.

Возможно, я бы зашла еще раз, потому что напитки мне понравились, было бы хорошо, если бы руководство обратило внимание на выше озвученные минусы
textTranslated:
The coffee shop has a very beautiful interior: large panoramic windows, lots of greenery, and beautiful flowers everywhere 😍 Lots of tables, two floors. There's also a shop with souvenirs and coffee.

We had a cherry cold brew, cappuccino, and red velvet. The coffee was good, and we especially liked the cold brew, but the cake was terrible 😖 It was dry and tasteless, clearly stale, like it had been sitting for 2-3 days. The place should pay attention to that.

Also on the downside: the very uncomfortable chairs, the table layout, and the service 😕 The staff seemed polite and spoke English, but they forgot to bring straws with our order. We went to ask for them and were immediately asked to pay. We hadn't left yet and would have paid anyway, but it seemed odd. Either ask for payment immediately after ordering, or bring the bill later, not like this.

I might come back again because I liked the drinks. It would be nice if management addressed the downsides mentioned above.
responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Nadezhda Morgunova, thanks for visiting Wonderlust and sharing your honest thoughts with us.
We’re really sorry this visit didn’t turn out as you hoped, and we’ll take it as a lesson to do better.
Hope we get to welcome you back next time for a more enjoyable experience.

-Wonderlust team-

text:
Wir waren heute bei WONDERLUST – Coffee und haben neben Kaffee auch das Tiramisu probiert. Das Tiramisu habe ich eher zufällig auf der Karte entdeckt und wegen des günstigen Preises bestellt – geschmacklich war es leider ein Reinfall, da es praktisch nach nichts geschmeckt hat. Für mich persönlich lohnt sich das nicht, auch wenn es vielleicht den Geschmack anderer trifft.

Dafür waren die Getränke umso besser: der Kokosnuss-Kaffee war richtig lecker und eine klare Empfehlung, auch der Cherry Cold Brew hat sehr gut geschmeckt. Preislich ist alles in Ordnung.

Die Location ist absolut beeindruckend – ideal, um schöne Fotos zu machen – und das Personal war sehr freundlich. Für den Kaffee würde ich jederzeit wiederkommen, beim Tiramisu würde ich aber passen.
textTranslated:
We went to WONDERLUST – Coffee today and tried the tiramisu in addition to the coffee. I discovered the tiramisu on the menu by chance and ordered it because of the low price – unfortunately, it was a complete disappointment, as it tasted of practically nothing. Personally, I wouldn't consider it worth it, even if it might appeal to others.

However, the drinks were all the better: the coconut coffee was really delicious and highly recommended, and the cherry cold brew was also very good. The prices were all reasonable.

The location is absolutely stunning – ideal for taking beautiful photos – and the staff was very friendly. I would definitely come back for the coffee, but I'd pass on the tiramisu.

text:
行完漢市場之後，大約行1分鐘就可以到達這間Wonderlust Bakery & Coffee 整體體驗非常不錯，環境寬敞舒適，有冷氣❄️⛄️！！

我點了鹽咖啡、椰子咖啡組合和香水氣泡茶（非常推薦）👍🏻👍🏻。每一款都讓人驚喜。😋鹽咖啡鹹甜平衡得剛好，椰子咖啡香濃順口，氣泡茶則清爽淡雅，非常適合午後放鬆。

唯一小小美中不足的是鬆餅（Fluffy Pancake），口感偏硬了一點，沒有預期中的鬆軟，不過搭配飲品還是可以接受。☘️

整體價格合理、服務也不錯，是峴港市區值得一訪的咖啡店。如果想找個地方坐下來好好享受咖啡時光，這裡是不錯的選擇！💕
textTranslated:
After visiting Han Market, it's about a 1-minute walk to Wonderlust Bakery & Coffee. The overall experience was excellent; the environment was spacious and comfortable, with air conditioning ❄️⛄️!!

I ordered the salt coffee, coconut coffee combo, and sparkling tea (highly recommended) 👍🏻👍🏻. Each one was a delightful surprise 😋. The salt coffee had a perfect balance of salty and sweet, the coconut coffee was rich and smooth, and the sparkling tea was refreshing and elegant—perfect for relaxing in the afternoon.

The only minor drawback was the fluffy pancake; it was a little firm and not as fluffy as I expected, but it was still acceptable with the drinks. ☘️

Overall, the prices are reasonable, and the service is good, making it a worthwhile coffee shop to visit in Da Nang city. If you want to find a place to sit down and enjoy a coffee time, this is a great choice! 💕

text:
Wonderlust Danang is part urban greenhouse, part community hub—a creative café where design lovers and digital nomads mingle over specialty coffee. Tucked into the heart of Da Nang, this plant-filled space is equal parts industrial and cozy, with huge skylights, hanging ferns, and a curated concept store offering local crafts, ceramics, and handmade gifts.

Baristas here are serious about their craft—espresso, pour-overs, and cold brew are all dialed in and paired with playful seasonal drinks like coconut coffee or floral-infused sodas. The pastry counter tempts with croissants, cookies, and cakes, and the brunch menu runs from smoothie bowls and fresh salads to hearty sandwiches and all-day breakfast.

This is the kind of spot you settle in for hours: free Wi-Fi, abundant outlets, a laid-back playlist, and sun-drenched corners for people-watching or creative work. Locals love it for meetings and meetups; travelers come for the Instagram-worthy setting and a chance to pick up a keepsake from the shop.

Pro tip: Order a coconut coffee and grab a seat under the skylight. Don’t leave without browsing the souvenir shelves for a slice of Da Nang style to take home.

• Vibe: Airy, creative, plant-filled community café
• Price: $ (drinks ~$2–$4 USD, brunch ~$4–$8 USD)
• Must-try: Coconut coffee, cold brew, smoothie bowl, souvenir shopping
• Accolades: Top-rated design café, favorite for locals and travelers

text:
I visited Wonderlust Coffee Joint hoping for a great Vietnamese coffee experience, but unfortunately, it fell far short. The coffee, while tolerable, was shockingly overpriced for what it delivered. Having spent time enjoying the incredible coffee scene across Vietnam, I can confidently say this wasn't even close to being in my top five. It lacked the depth, character, and authentic taste I've come to expect from quality Vietnamese brews.
While I'll concede the atmosphere was pleasant enough – a decent space to sit – that's where any positives end. Wonderlust feels less like a unique Vietnamese cafe and more like a local approximation of a Starbucks, but without any of the consistent quality or unique selling propositions that might justify its premium pricing. Save your money and seek out a more authentic and value-driven coffee spot.

Thank you once again.

text:
Vì chuyến bay bị trễ nên mình ghé quán dùng bữa. Quán mang phong cách Hong Kong khá đặc trưng, tuy nhiên không gian chưa thực sự sạch sẽ và gọn gàng như mong đợi.

Về phần phục vụ, nhân viên chưa tạo được thiện cảm vì thiếu sự niềm nở và thân thiện với khách hàng. Cá nhân mình đánh giá cao thái độ phục vụ chuyên nghiệp và một nụ cười khi tiếp đón khách.

Bù lại, nước lẩu có hương vị đậm đà, khá ngon và đáng để trải nghiệm. Nếu cải thiện thêm về dịch vụ và không gian, quán sẽ hoàn thiện hơn rất nhiều.

RCM mọi người có thể ghé thử và tự mình trải nghiệm nhé.
textTranslated:
Because my flight was delayed, I stopped by this restaurant for a meal. The restaurant has a distinctive Hong Kong style, however, the space wasn't as clean and tidy as I'd hoped.

Regarding service, the staff didn't make a good impression due to a lack of warmth and friendliness. Personally, I appreciate the professional attitude and a smile when greeting customers.

On the other hand, the hot pot broth was flavorful, quite delicious, and worth trying. With improvements in service and ambiance, the restaurant would be much better.

RCM, you can visit and experience it for yourself!
responseFromOwnerText: Trước tiên, Gangyu xin cảm ơn quý khách đã ghé trải nghiệm thưởng lẩu dù  thời gian đã khá trễ, đặc biệt Gangyu rất trân quý những đánh giá mà quý khách để lại. Về không gian nhà hàng, vì thời gian mở cũng đã hơn 6 năm, cơ sở vật chất không tránh khỏi xuống cấp, Gangyu vẫn đang tiến hành cải thiện từng hạng mục một nhằm nâng cấp không gian nhà hàng. Về thái độ phục vụ của nhân viên, Gangyu rất tiếc vì các bạn đã để lại ấn tượng không tốt vì chưa được thân thiện. Gangyu đã họp team và nhấn mạnh vấn đề quý khách đã đưa ra. Một lần nữa xin cảm ơn quý khách . Chúc quý khách một năm mới an khang, thịnh vượng, vạn sự như ý.

text: While the atmosphere of the cafe is modern and gorgeous, service was not pleasant and disappointing. We ordered the red velvet cake, which tasted like crayons and was quite dry. Highly disappointed and offended in the service and would not come again and would not recommend. Avoid this place like the plague.

responseFromOwnerText:
We’re sorry to hear about your unpleasant experience. Vietnamese coffee is made from Robusta beans, which are very high in caffeine. That’s why the serving size is smaller compared to other types of coffee. If consumed beyond the recommended amount, it can cause caffeine intoxication, which is not ideal. Vietnamese coffee is typically served in a 120ml portion due to its strong and concentrated nature. We hope for your understanding!

textTranslated: I found the staff here very taciturn. The security guard was enthusiastic, guiding customers to parking and greeting them at the door, but the staff outside just stared. text:
Overview:

Wonderlust Coffee & Souvenir is located only few minutes' walk from the beautiful Han river and busy Han market.

Service:
- Friendly and Fast
- Unfortunately, I was only given one glass of complimentary water, which was warm.
- Rating: 4/5

Atmosphere:
- Very modern design
- Very calm, cool and relaxing environment
- Nice quiet background music playing
- Rating: 5/5

My Order:
- Coco Citrus Cold Brew
- Description: We use some of the highest quality coffee. This coffee is brewed at cold temperature for 24 hours using a double filtration process to obtain the final result.
- A complex, clean and sweet brew with low acidity & smooth finish.

У нас было полчаса времени попить кофе, потом нужно было выдвигаться по делам.
Классный интерьер, очень приятно внутри. На этом плюсы закончились))
Взяли два колдбрю, неприятно удивил ценник. 75к - даже в крутых кофейнях он около 60. Ну ладно, платим за интерьер, подумали мы.

Сидим, ждем. Прошло 25 минут - кофе не был готов, пора выходить! Подошли вниз, напомнили, они вообще забыли. Сделали через 5-7 минут ещё. В итоге, больше 30 минут ждали, перенесли важные встречи)

Кофе - обычный, ничего особенного. Того не стоило, дорого, долго.
textTranslated:
We had half an hour to drink coffee, then we had to go run errands.
Cool interior, very pleasant inside. That's where the positives ended.
We ordered two cold brews and were unpleasantly surprised by the price. 75,000 rubles—even in fancy coffee shops it's around 60,000 rubles. Oh well, we're paying for the interior, we thought.

We sat and waited. 25 minutes passed—the coffee wasn't ready, time to go! We went downstairs and reminded them, but they'd completely forgotten. They made it again in 5-7 minutes. In the end, we waited over 30 minutes, and rescheduled important meetings.

The coffee was average, nothing special. It wasn't worth it; it was expensive and took a long time.

text:
Quán hotpot phong cách Trung Quốc này nhìn chung khá hài lòng. Menu nước lẩu rất đa dạng, từ thanh nhẹ cho đến cay nồng, hương vị đậm đà đúng kiểu Trung Hoa. Mình đặc biệt thích các loại nước lẩu thảo mộc và lẩu nấm, rất dễ ăn và hợp khẩu vị người Việt.

Riêng nước lẩu Tứ Xuyên đặc trưng thì hơi “quá tay” – cay gắt, mùi hăng mạnh, ăn một lúc là tê cả lưỡi. Có thể những ai mê vị cay xé lưỡi sẽ thích, nhưng với mình và nhiều bạn Việt thì hơi khó ăn.

Bù lại, đồ nhúng tươi, phục vụ nhanh, không gian quán sạch sẽ, đậm chất Trung Hoa. Nhìn chung là một địa điểm đáng thử nếu bạn thích trải nghiệm lẩu chuẩn vị Trung Quốc!
textTranslated:
This Chinese-style hotpot restaurant was generally quite satisfying. The broth menu is very diverse, ranging from light and refreshing to intensely spicy, with rich, authentic Chinese flavors. I especially liked the herbal and mushroom broths; they were easy to eat and suited Vietnamese tastes.

However, the signature Sichuan broth was a bit "over the top"—extremely spicy, with a strong, pungent smell that numbed my tongue after a while. Those who love intensely spicy food might enjoy it, but for me and many other Vietnamese people, it was a bit difficult to eat.

On the bright side, the ingredients were fresh, the service was quick, and the restaurant was clean and had a distinctly Chinese atmosphere. Overall, it's a place worth trying if you want to experience authentic Chinese hotpot!

text:
Tonight we came here for dinner and ordered hotpot. Our table was right next to the kitchen, and when one of the dishes (pate ball) was brought out, the waitress noticed it didn’t look right. She handed it to the chef, who looked at it for a while, hesitated, and didn’t seem sure either. In the end, they gave it back to us to put into the hotpot. For me, that was already a bad sign – the dish had a strange color and smell, so we decided not to touch it at all.

The next problem was with the glass – I was given a glass that was dirty on the inside. There was a lot of residue, which mixed into the water, and it was clearly visible. Only after I pointed it out did they automatically replace it with a clean glass and fresh water.

What surprised me the most was that they charged 5,000 VND for wet tissues, even though they had already been placed on the table. In most places these are free, but here they charged for them separately. The amount is small, but it’s the principle that matters.

Overall, it was quite disappointing.

textTranslated:
Wonderlust (Da Nang's Popular Cafe)

It's been raining every day in Da Nang these past few days, so we decided to find some cafes to take photos at, treating it like sightseeing. One of them was Wonderlust. We ordered two drinks, and about 15 minutes later, a staff member came over saying they'd forgotten what we ordered and we had to reorder. I was already a little annoyed; the staff member clearly hadn't bothered to remember what we chose. We continued waiting, and it took a long time. We had to urge the staff again, and almost 45 minutes passed before the first drink arrived. The other drink seemed to have disappeared, and the staff member didn't say when it would be ready. After waiting for another 10 minutes or so, I couldn't stand it anymore. Finally, I went downstairs and told the staff member that I had waited for over an hour—it was outrageous! Finally, he quickly prepared my drink. By the time it arrived, I had completely lost my appetite. I reluctantly finished the drink and left. The staff member apologized and didn't charge us.

text:
I found Wonderlust on TikTok and decided to try it myself. When I got there, I really liked the ambience and design of the coffee shop. It’s multi-story, with an open center, which makes it feel spacious. There’s also a section where they sell souvenirs like journals, notebooks, and other items.

I liked their coffee and also ordered their custard dessert. I didn’t realize it came with coffee and unknowingly poured it in, which made it super bitter—I didn’t enjoy that. But their cheesecake was really good.

It’s a nice place to chill, with reliable Wi-Fi. You can hang out, do some work, people-watch, or relax with friends. They also accept card payments, which is convenient.

text:
Gang Yu hotpot
During my 7-day stay in Da Nang, I craved spicy hot pot and found a highly rated spot on Google. I walked 20-25 minutes from my hotel, arriving just past 7 PM. We opted for the all-you-can-eat combo for two, choosing spicy Sichuan and a sour Tom Yum-like soup. The restaurant was quiet—only 2-3 tables downstairs, and an upstairs area with possible large party. The Sichuan soup outshined the Tom Yum, which was bland and disappointing, especially since reviews hyped it as the second-best soup. Service was slow even with 3-4 servers. In the kitchen, male meat cutters were flirting with a female waitress, who tried to deflect but struggled until I glared at one, signaling, “Where’s my meat?” Initially, the beef was thinly sliced and great, but after a few rounds, the slices thickened, becoming tough and ruining our vibe. I gave three stars for the spicy soup and overall meat quality. I hope they improve service and consistency for picky eaters like me.

textTranslated: I've eaten here many times before. But this time I went with my friend. The staff were inattentive. When customers ordered, they kept looking elsewhere and asking for their order again, sometimes repeating it three or four times. The restaurant was noisy, not because it was crowded, but because some people, who weren't staff members and I don't know who they were, were swearing loudly from the entrance to the restaurant. Then, at the counter, they were laughing, joking, and scrolling through TikTok at a very loud volume. The food was never served completely. Every time I eat here, it's the same situation. Every time I pay, the staff have to revise the bill.
responseFromOwnerText: Trước tiên, Gangyu xin cảm ơn mình đã nhiều lần ghé ủng hộ quán. Về vấn đề mình phản hồi, với cương vị quản lý, thay mặt nhà hàng xin lỗi mình. Em đã check cam và nhận thấy một số bạn bộ phận bếp đã ngồi tại vị trí thu ngân, nói chuyện gây ồn ào ảnh hưởng đến khách hàng. Vô cùng xin lỗi vì sự không chuyên nghiệp của bên em ảnh hưởng đến bữa ăn của mình. Bên em sẽ cố gắng cải thiện để không phát sinh trường hợp tương tự. mong mình thông cảm và bỏ qua. text: 異国で過ごす休日を満喫できました！美味しいマンゴージュースを飲みながら、炎天下の街の景色を扇風機にふかれながら、眺める。歩いてきた道のりを思いながらとっておきのご褒美をいただいている気分に浸れます。なにはさておき、マンゴージュース美味しすぎませんか？？？🥹💕飲みすぎたらおなかをこわしてしまうので1杯にとどめましたが、毎日飲みたい美味しさ！濃厚な甘味を程よくまろやかに仕上げてくださったスタッフさんに感謝です！！！！ダナンにきたらまた絶対マンゴージュースを飲みにきますね🥭✨
textTranslated: I thoroughly enjoyed my holiday in a foreign country! I sipped delicious mango juice while being fanned by a fan and gazing at the cityscape under the scorching sun. It felt like I was receiving a special reward as I reflected on the journey I had taken. But seriously, wasn't the mango juice just too delicious??? 🥹💕 I limited myself to one glass because drinking too much would upset my stomach, but it was so good I wanted to drink it every day! I'm grateful to the staff for creating such a rich and mellow flavor! ! ! ! If I come back to Da Nang, I'll definitely come back for more mango juice 🥭✨

textTranslated: I went to this restaurant with a friend; it seemed like a reliable place. But in the middle of the night, we both suffered from vomiting and diarrhea, becoming completely dehydrated. The food quality was seriously problematic. Avoid this place! I felt terrible all day, and I even developed a fever of 38 degrees Celsius 🤒 (I really didn't expect to be betrayed by a Chinese hot pot restaurant in Vietnam…)
responseFromOwnerText: 您好！首先谢谢您已经来店里用餐。作为个管理人、经过了解、我服务员说您在用餐的过程中没有表现什么问题、您点的菜品也不算少、您走的时候我们服务员也很热情的送客。但是当您反馈吃我们火锅后就发生问题、我觉得很可惜。如果您需要去医院检查或者要把我们的菜品去检查的话我们都会尽力支持。我们开业时间也是5年了。我们的客户不只是中国客人、还有本地客人、韩国客人、欧美老外的都有。对于每一位客人来店里用火锅，服务员都会咨询客人各种菜品的涮锅时间（如果客人需要），因为涮锅时间不够的菜品，会影响味道味道和影响其他问题。我们店里、除了服务质量、我们也特别注重原材料进货的质量、菜品质量。因为起码您也已经在我店里用过餐、所以、如果您需要去医院检查的话、我们可以叫车送您去、这也是我们的心意。谢谢！

☕ Đồ uống:
Menu đa dạng, đồ uống được pha chế khá chất lượng, vị ổn định. Giá cả hợp lý so với mặt bằng chung, phù hợp để ghé thường xuyên mà không “đau ví”.

📸 Không gian:

🌉 View & môi trường:
Quán có view nhìn ra sông và cầu Rồng khá “đắt giá”. Không gian luôn sạch sẽ, gọn gàng, tạo cảm giác dễ chịu khi ngồi lâu.

⭐ Tổng kết:
Út Tịch là một địa điểm đáng ghé mỗi khi đến Đà Nẵng, vừa đẹp, vừa chill lại có chất lượng phục vụ tố
textTranslated:
As someone who always visits Ut Tich every time I go to Da Nang, I have a really good impression of this cafe.

☕ Drinks:
The menu is diverse, and the drinks are quite well-made with consistent flavors. The prices are reasonable compared to the general average, making it suitable for frequent visits without breaking the bank.

🙋‍♀️ Staff:
The staff here are very enthusiastic and lovely. From the moment you enter until you leave, you feel their friendliness, and the service is quick and attentive.

📸 Atmosphere:
The interior of the cafe is beautifully designed, with many pretty corners for taking photos. The outdoor area is airy and cool, perfect for relaxing, especially in the afternoon or evening.

🌉 View & Environment:
The cafe has a stunning view of the river and the Dragon Bridge. The space is always clean and tidy, creating a pleasant feeling even when sitting for a long time.

⭐ In summary:
Ut Tich is a must-visit place whenever you come to Da Nang; it's beautiful, relaxing, and has excellent service.

I told her about the mistake and took the money. The owner didn't even apologize, just said, "Oh."

I told the customer that I should apologize first,

Please keep your change handy.

-Wonderlust team-

text: 峴港的咖啡店文化看來很濃厚，初來試了 Coconut Latte 及 Custard Pudding，Coconut 沒有想像中那麼濃味，McDonald's 果杯椰子同埋甜味會濃過佢哋呢杯，不過大家都知太甜對身體冇乜益（最後變脂肪），所以我覺得算係恰到好處啦！Pudding 🍮食落去不過不失，有支糖漿俾您擠下，另外俾杯碎冰您撈下等佢冇咁甜，算細心照顧食客味覺。環境不錯，有兩層，樓上冷氣不夠，樓下就夠冷氣喎！所以開頭上樓上，最後還是坐樓下感覺更良好。員工都很年輕，有幾個漂亮女孩服務，笑容親切。
textTranslated: Da Nang seems to have a strong coffee shop culture. On my first visit, I tried the Coconut Latte and Custard Pudding. The coconut flavor wasn't as strong as I expected; McDonald's fruit cup had a much stronger coconut and sweetness. However, everyone knows that too much sugar isn't good for your health (it eventually turns into fat), so I thought it was just right! The pudding 🍮 was decent, nothing special. They provide a syrup for you to squeeze in, and a cup of crushed ice to make it less sweet—a thoughtful touch. The ambiance is nice, with two floors. The air conditioning upstairs isn't enough, but downstairs is quite comfortable! So, I went upstairs at first, but ended up feeling better sitting downstairs. The staff are all young, with several pretty girls serving with friendly smiles.

text:
Út Tịch café is one of my favourite cafe when visiting the city side of Danang. They have two outlets, the other being on Bach Dang, overlooking the river.

Both sites have a uniquely lively Vietnamese atmosphere and street culture. There's a host of the tiny, low chairs to sit in on the pavement and more comfortable seating available inside including an air conditioned, no smoking room with comfortable sofas.

For me, their standout offering is their superb quality coconut coffee. Served in a large glass brim full with coconut ice milk and with a small glass shot of strong robusta coffee to pour over the coconut ice when you're ready. Alongside these, you receive a small bowl of delicious crunchy coconut chips to either nibble or sprinkle on your coffee as desired. It's an absolute joy to drink.
The staff are extremely helpful and the menu also has English translations alongside the Vietnamese names.

text: Lần đầu tiên chúng tôi đến đây vào ngày 9/3/2026 tại Số 59, Nguyễn Văn Linh, (  Tea & Coffee Phúc Long) thành phố Đà Nẵng, quán ít khách nhưng nhân viên phục vụ quá chậm, chúng tôi order 3 ly cà fe sữa từ 8:38, ngồi đến hơn 9h tôi phải từ tầng 2 đi xuống quầy trực tiếp hỏi tại sao ngồi lâu thế mà chưa có thì nhân viên mới bắt đầu pha chế. Trong khi quán không đông lắm. Đặc biệt lại còn có thái độ thiếu lịch sự, không tôn trọng khách hàng. Khi tôi bưng đồ uống lên tầng thấy bạn nam và bạn nữ cười với nhau mà không có một lời xin lỗi, giải thích vì sự chậm trễ của mình. Cần xem lại thái độ và sự thiếu chuyên nghiệp của nhân viên để nâng cao uy tín của thương hiệu mà quán đã tạo dựng được từ nhiều năm qua.
textTranslated: Our first visit was on March 9th, 2026, at 59 Nguyen Van Linh Street, (Phuc Long Tea & Coffee), Da Nang City. The shop wasn't very busy, but the service was extremely slow. We ordered three iced coffees at 8:38 AM, and after sitting there until past 9 AM, I had to go down from the second floor to the counter to ask why we were taking so long before the staff finally started preparing them. The shop wasn't very crowded, and the staff were particularly impolite and disrespectful. When I took my drinks upstairs, I saw a male and female staff member laughing together without any apology or explanation for the delay. The staff's attitude and lack of professionalism need to be reviewed to improve the reputation the shop has built over many years.

title: Phuc Long Coffee & Tea

text:
I didn't plan to visit this cafe, but a friend asked me to buy Phuc Long tea bags which I couldn't find at Go! Supermarket. I found this branch on Google Maps and decided to duck in to escape a heavy rainstorm.
The shop sells everything from tea bags and loose-leaf tea to various coffee blends. As it's a cafe, they also serve hot/iced drinks and pastries. The vibe is perfect for long stays; the second floor feels like a co-working space—great for working or catching up with friends.
I bought two boxes of Black Tea at a very good price. To my surprise, there was a promotion that gave me a free iced milk tea! I asked the staff for a recommendation, and they suggested the signature 'Phuc Long Milk Tea.' It’s nothing like the typical Taiwanese bubble tea. The tea aroma is incredibly bold and fragrant, with a deep, sophisticated bitterness that pairs perfectly with the smooth milk. Neither flavor overpowers the other. Even though I didn't take many photos of the interior to respect the privacy of the crowded shop, I highly recommend everyone try their milk tea. Great quality and prices!

title: Phuc Long Coffee & Tea

text: Nước lẩu chua cay hoàng đế rất ngon, chua chua như vị lẩu Thái, nước lẩu gà cũng ngon, có táo tàu ăn lạ miệng. Nhờ nhân viên pha dùm chén nước chấm phải nói là siêu ngon 😍 đồ ăn rất tươi, tươi hơn các quán lẩu khác nên giá thành cũng nhỉnh hơn, tiền nào của nấy. Bao tử cá basa ở đây lạ lắm, nấu chín vẫn màu đỏ nhưng ăn rất ngon và ko hề tanh như bao tử cá basa ở các quán khác, lá sách bò mềm nhúng cũng k bị dai, ko bị tanh, 10 điểm chất lượng và vệ sinh. Nhân viên cũng rất nhiệt tình và dễ thương. 👍👍👍
textTranslated: The Emperor's Spicy and Sour Hot Pot broth was delicious, with a sourness similar to Thai hot pot. The chicken broth was also good, with jujubes for a unique taste. Thanks to the staff for making the dipping sauce, it was absolutely amazing! 😍 The food was very fresh, fresher than other hot pot restaurants, so the price was a bit higher, but you get what you pay for. The basa fish stomach here was unique; it remained red even after cooking, but it was very tasty and not at all fishy like basa fish stomachs at other restaurants. The beef tripe was tender, not chewy, and not fishy when dipped in the broth. 10/10 for quality and hygiene. The staff were also very enthusiastic and friendly. 👍👍👍
responseFromOwnerText: Dạ Gangyu rất cảm ơn những đánh giá tích cực của mình ạ. Đây là động lực để bếp Gangyu cố gắng hoàn thiện mỗi ngày. Rất mong được gặp lại mình trong thời gian sớm nhất ạ!

textTranslated:
First of all, I found the milk tea here to have a strong tea flavor, but I extremely disliked the service from the staff. When I ordered the Black Tea with Milk, they didn't clearly explain whether I wanted it hot or iced. Then, when they brought out the hot cup, I went to exchange it for an iced cup, but the staff gave me a separate small cup of ice. I wanted to put the ice and milk tea in the large size cup I paid for, but the staff were reluctant to change it, and only did so after a while, but it felt forced.

In conclusion: I hope that the Phuc Long branch on Nguyen Van Linh Street in Da Nang will provide more training for their staff. I also hope the management will review their employee recruitment process. Poor service will negatively impact a branded milk tea company. Thank you!

textTranslated:
We had a special coconut coffee (80,000 VND) and a mango smoothie (75,000 VND). It was delicious, easy to drink, and trendy, but both the locals and us had a relaxing time. ✨ It's a place I'd love to return to.

We visited on February 17, 2026, right in the middle of Tet, the Vietnamese Lunar New Year.

Tet (Lunar New Year) in Vietnam in 2026 is a nine-day holiday from Saturday, February 14 to Sunday, February 22, centered around Tuesday, February 17, the first day of the lunar calendar. It's the most important holiday of the year, spent with family and relatives. While there was a rush of people returning home and stores were closing, this cafe was open and full, and both the locals and us, dressed in full for Tet, were able to relax and enjoy ourselves. ✨

With yellow walls, lanterns, and the Vietnamese flag,

It's a stylish cafe with a cultural atmosphere, immersing you in the Vietnamese atmosphere.

text: Chào team Phúc Long, mình xin chia sẻ trải nghiệm không mấy vui vẻ khi đến đây hôm nay. Chiều nay mình và bạn có đến uống nước trò chuyện như mọi lần nhưng lần này mình cảm thấy bạn nam nhân viên có vẻ tâm trạng không vui lắm nhỉ. Mình và bạn lên tầng chọn bàn và thấy một bàn trống cạnh đường có vẻ chưa được dọn vì khách đông nên tụi mình đã dọn ly và rác đi nhưng còn nước trên mặt bàn thì lúc đó mình thấy bạn ấy đến dọn các bàn khác thì mình có nói anh ơi lau nước ở bàn giúp em với ( chắc vì giọng mình khó nghe nên bạn í không rõ nên mình có nói lại thêm một lần ) chuyện sẽ chẳng có gì sau khi mình nhờ bạn í thì bạn quay lại cầm cái khăn lau bàn thả  khăn rơi tự do xuống chứ không phải cầm khăn đến lau. Mình cũng từng làm thêm phục vụ và hiện tại mình cũng làm trong ngành dịch vụ nhưng sau khi mình thấy như vậy kiểu mình tự hỏi là mình có đang sai không í hay là mình chưa hiểu rõ môi trường và quy trình tại đây.
textTranslated: Hello Phuc Long team, I'd like to share my unpleasant experience here today. This afternoon, my friend and I came to have drinks and chat as usual, but this time I felt the male staff member seemed rather unhappy. My friend and I went upstairs to choose a table and saw an empty table by the roadside that looked like it hadn't been cleaned because it was busy. We cleared our glasses and trash, but there was still water on the table. Then I saw him going to clean other tables, so I asked him, "Excuse me, sir, could you wipe the water off the table for me?" (I think because my voice was hard to hear, he didn't understand, so I repeated it). The situation would have been fine if he hadn't picked up the cloth to wipe the table instead of actually wiping it. I used to work part-time as a server and now I work in the service industry, but after seeing that, I wondered if I was doing something wrong or if I didn't fully understand the environment and procedures here.

text:
Tiếp nối thành công vang dội của các bộ sưu tập thức uống theo mùa trước đó, Phúc Long tự hào giới thiệu bộ sưu tập thức trà mới nhất cho tháng 7: "Danh Trà Thái Nguyên - Lục Bảo Tân Cương" với 2 sản phẩm chủ đạo là Lục Trà Sữa Tân Cương đậm đà và Lục Trà Tân Cương Mận Đỏ lừng danh, Phúc Long mong muốn mang đến những lựa chọn mới mẻ và hấp dẫn, đáp ứng đa dạng khẩu vị của người yêu trà.

Vùng đất trồng trà Tân Cương - Thái Nguyên đã nuôi dưỡng nên những lá trà non mơn mởn, mang hương vị đặc trưng, tinh túy của đất trời. "Lục Bảo Tân Cương" – cái tên như một ẩn dụ đầy thi vị, ví von những lá trà xanh Tân Cương quý báu như một bảo vật đượm màu xanh ngọc, mang đến giá trị tinh thần và sức khỏe vô giá cho người thưởng thức.

Lục Trà Sữa Tân Cương - Bản Hoà Tấu Lục Bảo Nhiều Tầng Hương

Không chỉ dừng lại ở sự kết hợp giữa Trà và Sữa thông thường, "Lục Trà Sữa Tân Cương" là một bản hòa tấu hoàn hảo giữa những búp trà non Thái Nguyên được tuyển chọn kỹ lưỡng cùng hương cốm non thơm ngát với vị sữa thơm dày vị với công thức pha chế độc quyền của Phúc Long.
Sự hòa quyện này tạo nên một thức uống vừa quen thuộc, gần gũi với hương vị truyền thống, vừa mới lạ, độc đáo. Mỗi ngụm "Lục Trà Sữa Tân Cương" là một hành trình khám phá nhiều tầng hương vị tinh tế, từ vị chát nhẹ đặc trưng của trà xanh Thái Nguyên đến vị ngọt thanh của sữa và hương thơm dịu dàng của cốm non. Tất cả tạo nên một trải nghiệm thưởng thức khó quên, đánh thức mọi giác quan của người yêu trà.

Lục Trà Tân Cương Mận Đỏ - Bản Tình Ca núi rừng Tây Bắc

Hoà vào khúc nhạc Lục Trà Sữa, trà trái cây "Lục Trà Tân Cương Mận Đỏ" là một khúc biến tấu đầy màu sắc của Phúc Long, nơi hương vị trà xanh Tân Cương thanh mát hòa quyện cùng vị chua ngọt tự nhiên của mận Hậu đỏ mọng vùng núi Tây Bắc. Sự kết hợp độc đáo này tạo nên một thức uống không chỉ thơm ngon mà còn mang đậm dấu ấn của thiên nhiên, núi rừng.
Mỗi ngụm "Lục Trà Tân Cương Mận Đỏ" như một bản tình ca thanh mát, đưa người thưởng thức đến với những cánh rừng bạt ngàn, cảm nhận sự tươi mát của đất trời và tinh túy của thiên nhiên. Vị chát nhẹ thanh khiết của Trà xanh, vị chua ngọt của mận Hậu tự nhiên hòa quyện vào nhau, tạo nên một trải nghiệm vị giác đầy tươi mới và sảng khoái.

Bộ sưu tập "Danh Trà Thái Nguyên - Lục Bảo Tân Cương" là minh chứng rõ nét cho cam kết của Phúc Long trong việc không ngừng nâng tầm trải nghiệm trà của khách hàng. Với sự kết hợp tỉ mỉ đầy chăm chút giữa nguyên liệu thượng hạng và công thức độc quyền, "Lục Trà Sữa Tân Cương" và "Lục Trà Tân Cương Mận Đỏ" đã nhanh chóng chinh phục những tín đồ trà khó tính nhất.
Phúc Long tin rằng, mỗi ly trà không chỉ là một thức uống đơn thuần mà còn là một tác phẩm nghệ thuật, một trải nghiệm văn hóa đầy tinh tế. Và bộ sưu tập "Danh Trà Thái Nguyên - Lục Bảo Tân Cương" chính là lời khẳng định mạnh mẽ cho sứ mệnh đó.
textTranslated:
Following the resounding success of previous seasonal beverage collections, Phuc Long proudly introduces its newest tea collection for July: "Thai Nguyen Famous Teas - Tan Cang Green Tea," featuring two flagship products: the rich and flavorful Tan Cang Green Tea with Milk and the renowned Tan Cang Green Tea with Red Plum. Phuc Long aims to offer fresh and appealing choices to satisfy the diverse tastes of tea lovers.

The Tan Cang tea-growing region of Thai Nguyen has nurtured tender, young tea leaves, imbued with the distinctive and exquisite flavors of nature. "Tan Cang Green Tea"—a poetic metaphor, likening these precious Tan Cang green tea leaves to a treasure imbued with emerald green, offering invaluable spiritual and health benefits to those who enjoy them.

Tan Cang Green Tea with Milk - A Multi-Layered Emerald Symphony

More than just a simple combination of tea and milk, "Tan Cang Green Tea with Milk" is a perfect symphony of carefully selected young Thai Nguyen tea leaves, fragrant young rice flakes, and rich, creamy milk, all crafted using Phuc Long's exclusive recipe.

This blend creates a beverage that is both familiar and comforting with its traditional flavor, yet novel and unique. Each sip of "Tan Cang Green Tea with Milk" is a journey of discovery through multiple layers of subtle flavors, from the characteristic mild bitterness of Thai Nguyen green tea to the delicate sweetness of milk and the gentle aroma of young rice flakes. All of this creates an unforgettable experience, awakening all the senses of tea lovers.

Tan Cang Green Tea with Red Plum - A Love Song of the Northwest Mountains

In harmony with the melody of green tea milk, the "Tan Cang Green Tea with Red Plum" fruit tea is a colorful variation from Phuc Long, where the refreshing taste of Tan Cang green tea blends with the naturally sweet and sour flavor of ripe red plums from the Northwest mountains. This unique combination creates a drink that is not only delicious but also deeply imbued with the essence of nature and the mountains.

Each sip of "Tan Cang Green Tea with Red Plum" is like a refreshing love song, transporting the drinker to vast forests, feeling the freshness of the earth and the essence of nature. The light, pure astringency of the green tea and the natural sweet and sour taste of the red plums blend together, creating a fresh and invigorating taste experience.

The "Thai Nguyen Famous Teas - Tan Cang Green Treasure" collection is clear evidence of Phuc Long's commitment to continuously elevating the tea experience for its customers. With a meticulous and carefully crafted combination of premium ingredients and an exclusive recipe, "Xinjiang Green Tea with Milk" and "Xinjiang Green Tea with Red Plum" have quickly won over even the most discerning tea connoisseurs.

Phuc Long believes that each cup of tea is not just a simple beverage, but also a work of art, a refined cultural experience. And the "Thai Nguyen Famous Teas - Xinjiang Green Tea" collection is a strong affirmation of that mission.

text:
한국 사람들도 꽤 보인다.
여기 어디 한시장이 있다고 하던데, 아마 오가는 길에 쇼핑하는 곳이 많은 거 같다.
일단 한국 사람에게 핫한 곳은 나는 피해 다닐려고 노력하는 편이다.
근데 뷰모리샵에 가는 길에 커피 한잔 하고 싶어 보니 이곳이었다.
까페 내부 인테리어 잘해놨네.
안에 앉았는데도 바깥에 뻥 뚫려있어 분위기 좋다.
이곳은 자리에 먼저 앉으면 직원이 와서 주문을 받는 시스템이다.
솔트커피를 한잔 시켰다. 45,000vnd.
맛있네? 섞어 먹으니 근데 몇번 빨대를 빨아보면 양이 많지가 않다.
단짠의 조화가 좋은 솔트커피...
2잔은 먹어야 될거 같다. ㅎㅎ
textTranslated:
I see quite a few Koreans around here.

I heard there is a market somewhere around here, so it seems there are plenty of shopping spots along the way.

I generally try to avoid places that are popular with Koreans.

But on my way to the Beaumori Shop, I wanted to grab a cup of coffee, and it turned out to be this place.

The cafe's interior is really well-designed.

Even though I'm sitting inside, the view is wide open to the outside, creating a nice atmosphere.

The system here is that you sit down first, and then a staff member comes over to take your order.

I ordered a cup of salt coffee. 45,000 VND.

It tastes good, actually. But after mixing it up, I realized the quantity isn't that much after taking a few sips through the straw.

Salt coffee with a great balance of sweet and salty...

I think I need to drink two cups. Haha.

text: Quá tệ so với nhiều quán lẩu khác trong thành phố với mức giá 1tr4 cho 4 người. Mình gọi buffet lẩu nhưng đồ ăn lên rất lâu và đến cuối bữa những món mình gọi vẫn chưa lên hết. Khi mình hỏi nhân viên lý do chậm trễ lên món thì nhận lại câu trả lời từ nhân viên là “nhân viên quên, khách đông và bếp bận” trong khi còn bàn trống rất nhiều. Dưới tâm lý khách hàng mình cần cách giải quyết của các bạn chứ không phải những lý do sáo rỗng như này. Đến lúc tính tiền các bạn cũng bắt mình đợi 1 hồi rất lâu. Nước lẩu thì nhạt, không chuẩn vị, quầy line thì không phong phú như các quán lẩu trung hoa khác mình từng thử. Nói chung là không xứng đáng với giá tiền về chất lượng và dịch vụ.
textTranslated: Terrible compared to many other hot pot restaurants in the city, especially considering the price of 1.4 million VND for 4 people. I ordered a hot pot buffet, but the food took a very long time to arrive, and even at the end of the meal, not all the dishes I ordered had been served. When I asked the staff for the reason for the delay, I received the answer "the staff forgot, it was crowded, and the kitchen was busy," even though there were many empty tables. As a customer, I need a solution from you, not these empty excuses. When it came time to pay, you also made me wait a very long time. The broth was bland and not authentic, and the buffet line wasn't as varied as other Chinese hot pot restaurants I've tried. In short, it's not worth the price in terms of quality and service.
responseFromOwnerText: Dạ, trước tiên Gangyu xin cảm ơn bạn và team đã ghé ủng hộ quán. Sự chiếu cố của bạn là niềm vinh hạnh cho quán. và Gangyu rất xin lỗi vì đã không thể mang lại cho bạn và team trải nghiệm tốt. Về phản hồi của bạn, Gangyu đã tiến hành họp để phê bình sâu sắc những cá nhân chưa làm tốt nhiệm vụ của mình . Về phục vụ, các bạn sẽ được trainning lại cách giải quyết vấn đề khi khách hối món hay hỏi nguyên nhân lên chậm món, phục vụ ngay món khách cần với tốc độ nhanh nhất. Về bếp, khảo hạch lại tốc độ lên món của các bạn, kiểm tra lại công thức làm nước lẩu, test lại vị tất cả các loại nước lẩu. Về thu ngân, khảo hạch lại tốc độ tính tiền, ưu tiên cho những khách đang vội, tránh tình trạng để khách chờ lâu. Về quầy line, vì diện tích quầy có hạn, Gangyu chỉ có thể làm thêm nhiều loại hơn để phục vụ thực khách. Với những vấn đề trên, một lần nữa Gangyu rất mong bạn sẽ lượng thứ cho Gangyu. Với tất cả sự biết ơn, Gangyu rất mong được đón tiếp bạn một lần nữa để có thể phục vụ bạn tốt hơn. Chúc bạn luôn khỏe mạnh và vui vẻ mỗi ngày!

text:
Visited this restaurant because the google review was good. However, the entire experience was not what we expected.
Food wise, it was average.  Nothing spectacular.
The entire experience was bad, mainly due to customer service.
We had to repeat our requests several time before they attended to us. There was no initiative from staffs such as offering to refill the soup.
Lastly, the most negative experience was that customers were smoking in the restaurant. We had informed the staff that the customers beside our tables are smoking and requested to change seats. Instead of changing seats, the staff went to talk to the smokers. Not sure what did the staff told the smokers. They stopped smoking and gave us a few stares. However, after 15 minutes or so, they started smoking again and no action was taken by the staff.
It was definitely a negative experience eating hotpot with a lot of smokers around you and nothing was done by the staff. If you are expecting non smoking environment or good service, this is not a place to visit.
responseFromOwnerText: I'm sorry you had a bad experience in our restaurant tonight. As a restaurant owner, I will ask the manager of the Da Nang restaurant to give an explanation tomorrow morning and impose penalties tomorrow. Thank you for your comments and wish you a pleasant trip in Danang.

If you want to avoid crowded cafes, I recommend this place.

In short, it was awful. The drinks were good, but I definitely wouldn't go to this store again.

text:
Bạn mình hẹn cf ở đây vào sáng sớm chủ nhật. Bạn mình đến trước chờ mình, mình đến sau nên order 1 mình. Mình order 1 ly trà trái cây giá 55k và thanh toán bằng tờ 500k vì mình ko có tiền lẻ. Lúc đó nhân viên order hỏi mình có tiền lẻ ko vì quán ko có tiền thối, mình bảo ko thì bạn ấy tỏ thái độ khó chịu hỏi lại có thể thanh toán bằng mã QR đc ko thì mình cũng bảo ko thể (vì mình ở nước ngoài về vn chơi, chỉ có thể xài tiền mặt) thì bạn ấy càng nhăn mặt hơn🙂🙂🙂
Rồi bạn ấy bảo “Thế thì chị đợi e một chút e đi đổi tiền để thối lại cho chị dc ko ạ?”, mình trả lời “Dạ được”. Nhưng ko, bạn ấy ko đi đổi tiền mà thối tiền ngay cho mình sau đó luôn🙂🙂🙂
Biết là VN đang chuộng thanh toán điện tử nhưng quán lớn như Phúc Long, nằm mặt tiền đường NVL mà thiếu chuẩn bị đến vậy sao?? Hay là có tiền thối nhưng lười thối??🙂🙂
Nhà vệ sinh thì ko có giấy vệ sinh, nước rửa tay thì hết. Sáng sớm mà đã như vậy thì chứng tỏ quán ko chuẩn bị để đón khách cho chu đáo.
Ly trà mình order sau đó mình nhận ra bạn nhân viên “thân thiện” ấy cũng ko hỏi size mà tự đặt luôn cho mình size L. Trà thì đắng và chát nên mình để lại hầu như hơn nửa ly… Sẽ không đi lại lần thứ 2 và cũng ko recommend cho bạn bè và người quen vào quán này.
textTranslated:
My friend and I arranged to meet here for coffee early Sunday morning. My friend arrived first and waited for me, but I arrived later and ordered alone. I ordered a fruit tea for 55k VND and paid with a 500k VND bill because I didn't have any change. The staff member asked if I had any change because the shop didn't have any change. I said no, and she got annoyed and asked if I could pay by QR code. I said no again (because I was visiting Vietnam from abroad and could only use cash), and she frowned even more. 🙂🙂🙂
Then she said, "Could you wait a moment while I go get some change?" I replied, "Yes, sure." But no, she didn't go get any change and gave me the change right away. 🙂🙂🙂
I know that electronic payments are becoming popular in Vietnam, but how could a large shop like Phuc Long, located on Nguyen Van Linh street, be so unprepared? Or maybe they had change but were too lazy to give it back?? 🙂🙂
The restroom had no toilet paper, and the hand sanitizer was gone. It was so early in the morning, it shows the shop wasn't prepared to welcome customers properly.
I later realized that the "friendly" staff member didn't even ask for the size of my tea, just ordered a large one. The tea was bitter and astringent, so I left almost half the cup untouched… I won't be going back a second time and I wouldn't recommend this place to friends or acquaintances.

Nhóm mình đi 7 người ăn buffet thì 3 người về đau bụng tiêu chảy cả đêm nằm bẹp ở nhà nguyên ngày hsau.

Đồ ăn gọi thì sau lượt đầu những lượt sau quán cố tình câu giờ mãi k đem đủ ra. Ai đời châm nước r cạn đến 3 lần vẫn k ra thịt, đợi lâu quá r bọn mình lửng bụng, lại thấy bàn mới đến sau quán bê đồ lên ngay nên mới  kêu nv có đem đồ ăn k thì báo cho khách 1 câu để khỏi phải chờ. Lúc ấy nv mới hậm hực đem ra cho tụi mình. Bàn mình toàn con gái ăn ít quán có cần thiết phải câu giờ đến thế không?

Đồ tráng miệng thì k giới thiệu cho khách là ở dưới tầng 1, ai biết thì tự lấy mà ăn còn không biết thì nhịn. Đã thế tào phớ còn thiu, khách ăn phải đến 1 câu xin lỗi cũng k có.

Khi về thì nv phục vụ thái độ ra mặt vì ra thịt chậm bị bàn mình nói, một câu chào khách cũng k thèm nói

Nói chung đến hnay mình vẫn đang bị đau bụng trong bực tức. Lúc đấy mình cũng ngu chứ đáng lẽ mình phải giữ lại 1 phần mẫu đồ ăn r báo quản lý thị trg ktra mới đúng.
textTranslated:
Our group of seven went to a buffet, and three of us ended up with stomachaches and diarrhea all night, lying bedridden the next day.

After the first round of food, the restaurant deliberately stalled, taking forever to bring out everything. They refilled the water three times and still didn't bring out the meat. We waited so long we were already quite full, and then we saw a new table arrive and they immediately brought their food. So we asked the staff if they had brought any food to let us know so we wouldn't have to wait. Only then did the staff reluctantly bring it out. Our table was full of girls who eat little; did the restaurant really need to stall like that?

The desserts weren't even listed as being on the first floor; those who knew could take it themselves, otherwise they'd have to go without. And to make matters worse, the tofu pudding was spoiled, and they didn't even apologize.

When we left, the staff were visibly upset because of the slow meat service and our complaints, and they didn't even bother to say goodbye.

In short, I'm still suffering from stomachaches and feeling angry today. I was stupid back then; I should have kept a sample of the food and reported it to the market management for inspection.

textTranslated:
I stopped by because I wanted to eat Chinese-style hot pot.

It's conveniently located in downtown Da Nang, so I stopped by after getting a massage. Since the owner is Chinese, the taste was as good as the hot pot you'd find in Dongdaemun.

The staff recognized that I was a Korean customer and treated me well; they were kind and nice.

However, there were some shirtless, tattooed Chinese people eating on the first floor, and it was noisy and uncomfortable.

I couldn't understand why they take off their shirts to eat in a restaurant.

Oh! When choosing your menu here, if you select the all-you-can-eat option, there are some items that aren't included in the all-you-can-eat list.

Things like shrimp balls... I like eating shrimp balls in hot pot, so I just ordered extra.

There are premium items in the "order only" menu that aren't available on the all-you-can-eat list, so please keep that in mind.

You make your own sauces, and when you leave, there is free dessert/snack ice cream in front of the counter.

text:
Vị trí đắc địa.
Đồ uống thì mình mua cho người thân chứ ko uống trà sữa nên không biết.
Về cách phục vụ:
- oder tại quầy như các chuỗi đồ uống nước ngoài
- mình đi chủ nhật nên hàng rất dài. Để oder được mất tầm 10p.
- sau khi thanh toán và nhận thẻ đợi thì phải mất 40p không thấy thẻ rung, mình lại hỏi thì nhân viên nói đơn xong lâu rồi. Mà chẳng thấy thông báo gì mình.
- đơn 4 ly thì làm có 3 ly (ae mua hộ nhớ kiểm tra nhé), dặn bỏ đá thì chỉ cho nước thôi. Gói đồ 4 ly không thể cho thêm đá, ai mang đi xa thì chịu.
- về không gian thì khá sạch và thoáng. Có điều nên tránh điều hoà vì nước nhỏ giọt xún tần suất cũng hơi dài.
- giá cả thuộc mức cao.
=> Chắc là mình khó tính quá chứ không phải người tiêu dùng Việt Nam mình dễ dãi.  Bỏ ra 215k để mua 4 ly nước và quan trọng nhất là đợi gần 1h đồng hồ.
Nhân viên ko có lỗi, mà người làm Quy trình có vấn đề. Chẳng biết họ có giữ nguyên cách vận hành này thêm vài năm nếu như khách vẫn chấp nhận được hay không.
textTranslated:
Prime location.

I bought drinks for a relative, not bubble tea, so I don't know about the service.

Regarding service:
- Ordering at the counter is like other foreign beverage chains.
- I went on Sunday, so the line was very long. It took about 10 minutes to order.

- After paying and receiving the card, I waited 40 minutes without the card vibrating. When I asked again, the staff said the order was ready a long time ago, but I didn't receive any notification.

- I ordered 4 drinks but only got 3 (remember to check if you're buying for someone else). I asked for ice, but they only put water in. They can't add ice to a 4-drink package, so it's impossible for those taking it far away.

- The space is quite clean and airy. However, you should avoid the air conditioning because the water drips quite frequently.

- Prices are high.

=> Maybe I'm being too picky, not that Vietnamese consumers are generally easygoing. I spent 215k VND for 4 drinks and, most importantly, waited almost an hour. The employees are not at fault; the people who created the process are the problem. I wonder if they'll keep this operating method for a few more years if customers still accept it.

text: Even compared to other Phuc Longs in Vietnam, the service here is appalling. Half a dozen staff shift around behind the counter, seemingly without purpose or passion, and when you finally get your order and money taken, you get a little beeper that tells you when you have to come back to the counter and pick up your own drink. If you try and wait for your drink, you get told to take a seat somewhere and this place is large with two floors, so that can mean quite a trek to retrieve your drinks simply because they have decided on a customer unfriendly policy of not delivering to tables. We waited 15 minutes and still no ‘beeping’ so went down to inquire about our drinks and the six staff members were all just moving like the walking dead, and when I explained that we’d been waiting 15 minutes, I didn’t get a smile or apology but they did finally start preparing our drinks. I implore you to visit one of the many unique and friendly cafes in Danang where you have interesting, non standardised decor, cheerful service to your table, a large choice of delicious beverages to select from, and where the money goes to help a local business instead of a profit obsessed, faceless franchise like Phuc Long or Highlands Coffee. Choose the righteous path and be rewarded in a coffee heaven!

- Strawberry oolong tea + coconut jelly: Delicious, fragrant, and refreshing. The coconut jelly was average.

text:
Quy trình phục vụ có vấn đề. Mình đi khung giờ cực ít khách mà vẫn đợi món cực lâu. Chỉ có 1 quầy order. Xếp hàng đợi tới lượt rồi mà khách vẫn còn xem menu để suy nghĩ gọi món nên chờ rất lâu. Nên bố trí thêm 1 menu nữa để người xếp hàng lựa món sẵn, khi tới lượt mình thì gọi luôn đỡ mất công suy nghĩ làm người sau phải chờ đợi. Đợi nước ra cũng rất lâu. Cũng phải 15-20 phút dù rất ít khách. Tội mấy bạn shopee food đợi cả nửa tiếng mà vẫn chưa có. Rất ức chế.
- Góc tầng 2 bị dột nước lâu nay. Nước rơi xuống laptop của mình. Phản ánh nhân viên mà không thấy khắc phục.
textTranslated:
The service process is problematic. I went during off-peak hours but still had a very long wait for my food. There's only one ordering counter. Even while waiting in line, customers are still looking at the menu to decide what to order, so the wait is very long. They should add another menu so people in line can choose their dishes in advance, and order immediately when it's their turn, saving them the trouble of thinking and making others wait. Waiting for drinks also takes a very long time, about 15-20 minutes even with very few customers. It's frustrating for Shopee Food delivery drivers who have to wait half an hour.

- There's been a leak in the corner of the second floor for a long time. Water has been dripping onto my laptop. I've complained to the staff but nothing has been fixed.

textTranslated: Phuc Long's drinks are always top-notch, especially the tea-based drinks like peach tea, milk oolong tea, milk black tea, etc. The strong tea flavor suits my taste perfectly. However, they still don't have many topping options to add to their drinks. The cakes here are also very delicious, especially the salted egg croissant. This Phuc Long branch only excels in those two aspects, nothing more. The space is average; sitting outside in the evening is nicer. The air conditioning is always malfunctioning, and the drip tray is broken. Drinks take a long time to come out, and the staff are indifferent and uncaring. Don't expect anything more than a delicious drink here. Customer service at Phuc Long Lotte is better.

text:
Út Tịch được thiết kế theo phong cách cổ điển và rất nhẹ nhàng tựa như Phố cổ Hội An thu nhỏ giữa lòng thành phố. Quán nằm tại số 100 Bạch Đằng rất dễ tìm thấy với không gian được thiết kế 3 tầng, rộng và thoáng mát.

Út Tịch là nơi thích hợp cho những ai thích sự yên tĩnh, nhẹ nhàng. Chiếc lồng đèn, bức tường vàng, bàn ghế gỗ, dàn hoa giấy xinh xinh hoà với bài nhạc ngọt ngào và êm dịu... tất cả đều mang lại cảm giác thư thái và tuyệt vời.

Menu đồ uống tại Út Tịch rất đa dạng, cafe ngon. Đặc biệt là các món sinh tố trái cây tươi như: Xoài; Dâu tây; Bơ;.. uống rất thơm ngon và bổ dưỡng với các mức giá trung bình từ 30k-50k/1ly thì hoàn toàn xứng đáng để thưởng thức.
textTranslated:
Ut Tich is designed in a classic and very gentle style, like a miniature Hoi An Old Town in the heart of the city. Located at 100 Bach Dang Street, it's easy to find, with a spacious and airy three-story design.

Ut Tich is suitable for those who like peace and quiet. The lanterns, yellow walls, wooden tables and chairs, pretty bougainvillea flowers, combined with sweet and soothing music... all create a relaxing and wonderful atmosphere.

The drink menu at Ut Tich is very diverse, and the coffee is delicious. Especially noteworthy are the fresh fruit smoothies such as mango, strawberry, and avocado... which are very tasty and nutritious, with average prices ranging from 30k-50k VND per glass – definitely worth trying.

text:
호이안을 걷다가 더위를 피해 우연히 들어간 웃 띠크 카페(OOTIQUE Café), 기대하지 않았던 만큼 더욱 만족스러웠던 곳이었습니다. 에어컨이 정말 시원하게 잘 나와서 무더운 날씨 속에 잠시 숨 돌리기에 딱 좋았고, 실내 분위기도 깔끔하고 아늑했어요.

무엇보다 마신 망고 스무디가 정말 신선하고 진한 맛이어서 감탄했을 정도였고, 더위에 지친 몸을 제대로 살려줬습니다. 다른 메뉴들도 기대해볼 만할 것 같아요.

또한 직원분들이 굉장히 친절하고 세심하게 응대해 주셔서 기분 좋게 쉴 수 있었습니다. 단순한 카페를 넘어, 여행 중 잠시 편안함을 느낄 수 있었던 소중한 공간이었습니다. 호이안에 방문하신다면 더위를 식히기 좋은 휴식처로 꼭 추천드리고 싶어요
textTranslated:
While walking around Hoi An, I stumbled upon OOTIQUE Café to escape the heat, and it turned out to be even more satisfying precisely because I hadn't expected much. The air conditioning worked perfectly, providing a cool respite from the sweltering heat, and the interior was clean and cozy.

Above all, the mango smoothie I had was so fresh and rich that I was truly amazed; it really revitalized my body, which was exhausted from the heat. I think the other menu items are worth looking forward to as well.

Furthermore, the staff were incredibly kind and attentive, allowing me to rest in a pleasant atmosphere. More than just a simple café, it was a precious space where I could find a moment of comfort during my trip. If you visit Hoi An, I highly recommend this as a great resting place to cool off.

text:
Đáng ra vote 1 sao, nhưng nhờ bác bảo vệ vớt vác lại được chút.
Đến quán lúc trời đang mưa to, thật tệ khi phải di chuyển từ bãi xe vào đến cửa quán hơn 20m dưới mưa, không có mái che, không có ô. Mình không hiểu vì lí do gì mà bạn quản lý đứng ở bãi xe tỏ thái độ khó chịu với mình khi mình gởi áo mưa chỗ dù của bác bảo vệ, và không quên chèn thêm câu nói: "Công ty cấm treo áo mưa để đây", mình hỏi bạn chỉ giúp mình chỗ treo, thì bạn quản lý chỉ mình mấy cái ghế ngoài trời đang thấm đẫm nước mưa kèm thái độ hằn học (!?) Cảm ơn bác bảo vệ đã nhiệt tình hỗ trợ dù trời mưa to và mình bác phải quán xuyến hết cả bãi xe.
textTranslated:
I would have given it 1 star, but thanks to the security guard, it was somewhat salvaged.
I arrived at the restaurant in heavy rain, and it was terrible having to walk over 20 meters from the parking lot to the entrance in the rain, with no shelter or umbrella. I don't understand why the manager standing in the parking lot was so annoyed when I left my raincoat near the security guard's umbrella, adding, "The company prohibits hanging raincoats here." When I asked him to show me where to hang it, the manager pointed to some outdoor chairs soaked with rainwater with a resentful attitude (!?). Thanks to the security guard for his enthusiastic assistance despite the heavy rain and the fact that he was the only one managing the entire parking lot.

text: 콩카페도 좋아하지만 웃띠끄도 좋아요. 여긴 카드결제도 되고 사람도 더 한산합니다. 대부분은 일층 스트리트 쪽에 자리를 하셔서 복잡해보이는데, 조용한 분위기 원하시면 2층으로 올라오시면 됩니다. 호이안 분위기의 인테리어라고 하던데 그래서인지 노란색과 좀 더 베트남 전통적인 인테리어들이 있어서 이쁘구요. 포토존도 있어요. 직원들이 서비스에 집중하고 있어서 2층에 앉아도 불편하지 않고요. 시그니처가 망고스무디랑 소금커피라는데 둘다 좋았습니다. 양도 충분히 많고 소금크림커피는 개인적으로 한국에서 먹는 커피들보다 훨씬 더 맛있었어요. 쟈스민티도 내주시고, 테이블위에 있는 해바라기씨(코코넛향이 입혀져있음)는 돈을 내는거지만(20K) 심심풀이로 먹기도 재밌고 맛도 좋으니 시도해보세요.
textTranslated: I like Cong Cafe, but I also like Uttique. They accept card payments here, and it's less crowded. Most people sit on the street side of the first floor, so it looks busy, but if you prefer a quiet atmosphere, you can come up to the second floor. I heard the interior has a Hoi An vibe, and perhaps that's why it's pretty with yellow and more traditional Vietnamese decor. There is also a photo zone. The staff are focused on providing good service, so sitting on the second floor isn't uncomfortable. I heard their signature drinks are the mango smoothie and salt coffee, and both were good. The portions are generous, and personally, the salt cream coffee tasted much better than the coffee I've had in Korea. They also serve jasmine tea, and while you have to pay for the coconut-flavored sunflower seeds on the table (20K), they are fun to snack on and taste good, so give them a try.

text: ダナン大聖堂から歩いている時に見つけました。お店は道路の角に立地していて、開放感があるお店です。基本的には暑いです。店員さんにレコメンデーションを聞いたところ、定番のココナッツアイスとコーヒーをお勧めされました。ベトナムコーヒーらしいビターな味とココナッツは相性は良いです。特にこのお店のココナッツミルクは甘すぎず良かったです。付いてくるお菓子も美味しいです。ベトナムカフェらしい、雰囲気、調度品も映えます。
textTranslated: I found this shop while walking from Da Nang Cathedral. It's located on a road corner and has an open feel. It's generally hot. I asked the staff for a recommendation, and they recommended the classic coconut ice cream and coffee. The bitter taste of Vietnamese coffee goes well with coconut. The coconut milk in this shop is particularly good, not too sweet. The accompanying sweets are also delicious. The atmosphere and furnishings are typical of a Vietnamese cafe.

textTranslated:
The exterior and interior are lovely, reminiscent of Hoi An.

The first floor is usually quite crowded, but when I went on a weekday afternoon, the second floor was completely empty, and I had it all to myself.

The wooden space was so relaxing, and the pleasant breeze and sunlight coming in made it very enjoyable.

The coconut drink was 65k. It was delicious. It's a little pricey compared to other cafes, but the staff were very friendly, and I was very satisfied.
