text:
#뷰모리 맞은편에 있어서 뷰모리 쇼핑 후 들렀어요. 처음엔 분위기에 혹 했는데 코코넛 커피에 두번 홀렸네요.
나오자마자 홀려서 먹느라 사진은 찍지도 못했다는.....ㅠㅠ

엄마도 좋아해서 나이 상관없이 좋아할 맛이에요. 구운 코코넛과 너무 달지않은 맛이 너무 좋았습니다.

식상한 곳은 별로 안좋아해서 호텔도 알려지지않은(지금은 아닐수도) 곳을 선별했는데, 콩카페는 아예 안간 저한테 여긴 완전 취저였어요. 가보시면 후회는 없을듯.

그리고 실수로 물건을 놓고나왔는데 빠르게 챙겨서 가져다준 예쁜 여직원분 너무 감사했어요~
textTranslated:
Since it is located across from Vumori, I stopped by after shopping there. I was initially drawn in by the atmosphere, but I was completely captivated by the coconut coffee.

I was so hooked that I couldn't even take a picture while eating it as soon as it arrived... ㅠㅠ

My mom liked it too, so it’s a flavor that everyone enjoys regardless of age. The roasted coconut and the taste, which wasn't too sweet, were fantastic.

I don't really like cliché places, so I specifically selected a hotel that wasn't well-known (though that might still be the case now). As someone who had never been to Cong Cafe before, this place was totally my style. I don't think you'll regret visiting.

Also, I accidentally left something behind, and I was so grateful to the lovely female staff member who quickly retrieved it and brought it back to me.

textTranslated:
The place is decent but lacks a standout feature!

• Spacious indoor and outdoor seating area with air conditioning.

• Today I sat inside the traditionally decorated Vietnamese-style room, with dim lighting and super cold air conditioning.

• The food is delicious, the guava juice is fragrant and not overly sweet.

• The menu is diverse, with prices ranging from 25-55, suitable for both locals and foreigners.

(-) The only negative point I'd like to suggest is that one male server placed the coaster a bit too roughly, like he was dealing cards rather carelessly.

📍Actual review on August 16, 2024

タイなんかは日本人も韓国人も同じくらいか日本人の方が多いくらいだけど、ベトナムは圧倒的に韓国人の方が多い印象。

textTranslated:
I went to the cafe next door, but it was incredibly crowded, so I went to the cafe next door.
However, this area, from Da Nang Cathedral to Con Market, is packed with Koreans. Korean is being spoken everywhere. Is it popular in Korea?
In Thailand, there are about the same number of Japanese and Koreans, or even more Japanese, but in Vietnam, there seems to be an overwhelming number of Koreans.

At this cafe, I ordered a Salted Coffee.
The coffee was sweet, but the salty cream on top was delicious 😋
The atmosphere inside was also nice.
There are many air-conditioned areas, so it's nice and cool.

This is a must-visit cafe when I visit Da Nang.

text:
- Quán có chỗ ngồi trong nhà và ngoài trời, trong nhà có điều hòa nên mát mẻ, không gian rộng rãi nhưng đi giờ cao điểm tầm 20h cũng khó kiếm được chỗ ngồi, xe máy thì phải gửi bên kia đường rồi đi bộ qua cũng rất bất tiện. Không gian trong nhà cách âm khá tốt, đông khách nhưng không quá ồn, vẫn có thể nói chuyện được.
- Món sô cô la đá xay mình gọi pha bị ngọt nên không thích lắm nếu bạn nào thích vị đắng thì nên gọi sô cô la hạnh nhân pha với espresso, còn bánh sừng trâu kim sa thì bánh bị giòn, phần kim sa bên trong ít tới mức ăn nửa miếng bánh rồi mà kim sa còn không chảy ra. Giá cả thì tương đương với những quán xung quanh, mình thấy giá vậy là hợp lý.
- Cập nhật ngày 29/12/2019: Hôm nay quán phục vụ đồ uống khá lâu, mình gọi sô cô la nóng và cafe vani mà chờ gần 20p mới có dù lượng khách vào quán không phải là đông lắm. Quán nên cải thiện tốc độ pha chế đồ uống.
textTranslated:
- The cafe has indoor and outdoor seating. The indoor area is air-conditioned, making it cool and spacious, but it's difficult to find a seat during peak hours around 8 PM. Motorbikes have to be parked across the street, and walking back is inconvenient. The indoor area is quite well soundproofed; it's busy but not too noisy, and you can still have conversations.

- The iced chocolate I ordered was too sweet, so I didn't like it much. If you prefer a bitter taste, you should order the almond chocolate with espresso. The croissants were too crispy, and the salted egg yolk filling was so sparse that even after eating half a croissant, the yolk hadn't melted. Prices are comparable to other cafes in the area, and I think they're reasonable.

- Update December 29, 2019: Today, the cafe took quite a long time to serve drinks. I ordered hot chocolate and vanilla coffee and waited almost 20 minutes, even though the cafe wasn't very crowded. The cafe should improve its drink preparation speed.

The drinks are really delicious. But friendliness? I'm not so sure. When I was ordering, they gave me dirty looks because I was frustrated that we couldn't communicate, and the outdoor area is full of smokers.

The salt coffee is worth trying at least once. Unlike in Korea, it's incredibly strong and sweet, so it's tasty.

But for me, one time is enough. I won't go a second time.

textTranslated:
This is the first time in my life I've tasted coconut coffee, plus my first mango smoothie on my trip to Vietnam!

The coconut coffee tastes like eating coconut cookies with milk? It tastes like a "Deowisanyang" (a Korean ice cream bar) with added coconut flavor, but it is smooth and not too thick.

It is an iced pie, but it is a good experience to try.

They even put fresh mango slices on top, and the mango is rich and delicious ❤️ They must have noticed we looked hot, because they guided us to a cool air-conditioned room, and the cold jasmine tea they gave us was heavenly because of the heat.

Even my mother, who doesn't usually like tea, said it was good, so we were planning to buy some. I was so grateful that a kind and cute female staff member showed us a picture of the product we bought and told us where to buy it!

I don't have a photo because I drank it in a hurry :)

I don't know how delicious Cong Cafe is, but!

The interior, the taste, and the friendliness were all 👍

The photo is of Uttik Cafe near Bach Dang Street :)

Cafes on Bach Dang Street serve plain water, while cafes near Han Market serve jasmine tea!

text:
Vô cùng thất vọng!
Thứ nhất, mình vào quán trước giờ bay 2 tiếng, định ngồi đó khoảng 1 tiếng rồi ra sân bay vì mình check in online xong hết rồi, lúc đó quán khá đông nhưng mình chỉ mất 5p đợi đến lượt order nên nghĩ không vấn đề gì. Ngoài ra mình đã cẩn thận dặn thu ngân là làm nhanh giúp mình vì mình sắp phải ra sân bay. Ok đông mình có thể đợi 1 chút không vấn đề gì, nhưng không, mình đã ngồi đợi ở đó đúng 1 tiếng đồng hồ cho 2 cốc nước, trong khi rất nhiều người đến sau mình họ được nhận đồ trước? Mình xuống hỏi đến hai lần đều nhận lại thái độ thờ ơ lạnh nhạt của nhân viên. Đấy là cách các bạn phục vụ khách hàng sao?
Thứ 2, khi mình đến quán, bác bảo có kêu để xe vào một chỗ ( bác chỉ ra đó) rồi tí bác dắt vào. Bạn mình làm đúng y lời bác. Sau khi nhận đồ ra về, mình thấy xe máy của 2 đứa mình bị vứt chỏng chơ giữa lòng đường?
Mình đã từng vào Phúc Long trên Hà Nội và thực sự hài lòng, nhưng ở đây thì mình không chấp nhận được. Phúc Long Đà Nẵng là trải nghiệm tệ nhất của mình tại thành phố này. Ý thức kém từ trong ra ngoài. Hứa không bao giờ quay lại.
textTranslated:
Extremely disappointed!

First, I went to the cafe two hours before my flight, intending to sit there for about an hour before heading to the airport because I had already checked in online. The cafe was quite crowded, but I only waited 5 minutes for my order, so I thought it wouldn't be a problem. I also carefully asked the cashier to hurry because I was about to leave for the airport. Okay, I could wait a little while because it was crowded, but no, I sat there for exactly an hour for two drinks, while many people who arrived after me received their orders first? I went down to ask twice and received only indifferent and cold attitudes from the staff. Is that how you serve customers?

Second, when I arrived at the cafe, the owner said to park the motorbike in a designated spot (he pointed there) and he would bring it back later. My friend did exactly as he said. After receiving our order and leaving, I found our motorbike left haphazardly in the middle of the road?

I've been to Phuc Long in Hanoi and was really satisfied, but I can't accept it here. Phuc Long Da Nang was my worst experience in this city. Poor service from inside out. I promise I'll never go back.

textTranslated:
Staff's attitude when using VNPAY.
Nearly a dozen people arrived before me and ordered food and received their takeout. Meanwhile, I waited a very long time and received nothing. The manager's attitude was unacceptable. When I reminded them, they were rude and very unpleasant. I don't understand what impact paying with VNPAY has on them that they have such a disrespectful attitude. I am extremely disappointed with the service attitude of Phuc Long Da Nang and I think you should review the manager's attitude (Evening shift at 10 PM on September 17th). I am a big fan of Phuc Long and after this experience, I will definitely never return again.

No way! The staff aren't trained! They serve like they don't care about customers! My friend ordered iced black coffee, but they brought iced milk! Even if they misheard, they could have just exchanged the coffee, it wouldn't cost much anyway). But I was too tired, so I just drank it anyway.

And then there was the coconut milk coffee! It gave me a stomach ache! And you can't blame it on another place! It was 6 pm, and I hadn't eaten or drunk anything since noon.

text:
Mình thích nhất là món cà phê dừa nên hầu như khi oder cà phê ở quán nào mà có món này mình đều thử hết. Tình cờ một lần được mời cà phê bạn mình gửi link quán này nên mình oder thử.  Cà phê bỏ ly giấy thân thiên với môi trường nè hihi.  Chất lượng khá ok nhé, ngon đấy quán này nghe nói đây là món nên thử nhất thì phải ấy.  Mình oder quá now nên được deal giảm giá thành thử cũng không quá mắc tiền lắm hihi. Now giao hàng lanh lẹ nhiệt tình.

Có thể nói đây là một khgian thu nhỏ của Hội An, từ cách decor quán cho tới những thứ nhỏ nhặt như cây cảnh vẫn giống luôn. Buổi tối ngồi phía ngoài vẫn thích hơn ngồi bên trong, được nhìn đường, nhìn xe cô đi qua thích thích 👏 nhưng vì mình đi trễ nên đành phải vào trong ngồi vì bên ngoài full chỗ luôn.  Nhưng bản thân mình hơi ngợp với menu ở đây í, trên hẳn 30k luôn. Hình như mình nhớ kh lầm thì ly cf thường, với sữa đã là 35 rồi í. Còn chưa kể những món best như cf dừa hay sinh tố xoài là 49 😂 Tuỳ từng vị nước chứ như sinh tố xoài với mình thì hơi nhiều đá, kh đậm vị xoài với vị sữa mấy, thành ra hơi nhạt 🤙 dù sao thì cũng nên đi thử cho biết nè
textTranslated:
My favorite is coconut coffee, so I try it at almost every cafe I order from that serves it. I happened to be invited for coffee once, and a friend sent me a link to this place, so I ordered some. The coffee comes in eco-friendly paper cups, haha. The quality is pretty good, it's delicious! I heard this is the must-try item at this cafe. I ordered through Now and got a discount, so it wasn't too expensive, haha. Now's delivery was quick and enthusiastic.

You could say this is a miniature Hoi An, from the decor to the little things like the plants, everything is the same. Sitting outside in the evening is still better than inside; you can watch the street and the cars go by, which is nice 👏 but because I arrived late, I had to sit inside because the outside was full. However, I was a bit overwhelmed by the menu here; everything is over 30k. If I remember correctly, a regular coffee with milk is already 35k. Not to mention the best items like coconut coffee or mango smoothie which are 49 😂 It depends on the drink, but for me, the mango smoothie had too much ice, not a strong mango or milk flavor, so it was a bit bland 🤙 Anyway, you should definitely try it!
